title: Hanil Corporate Center
description: This modern corporate building blends minimalist gray brick facades with expansive glass walls. A central open-air courtyard with lush bamboo provides a tranquil, nature-integrated ambiance. Interiors feature industrial-chic elements like stainless steel and vibrant neon accents, offering a sophisticated and highly functional dynamic workspace.

title: Modular Reflective Exhibition Space
description: This minimalist exhibition space pairs raw polished concrete with crisp white walls and subtle wood accents. The centerpiece is a series of modular, mirrored stainless steel plinths. These versatile blocks can be reconfigured from a solid mass into scattered pedestals, offering dynamic and highly flexible layouts for diverse artistic displays.

title: bon hotel // suwon
description: A residential monograph weaving stratified board-formed concrete and porous volcanic basalt, capturing the temporal passage of natural light. Rejecting superfluous ornamentation, the residence crafts a meditative spatial emptiness through the delicate counterpoint of illuminated apertures and shadow.
